subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in normal-session max-age/max-turn automatic rotation policy, and what continuity guarantees must it provide before a stale session is replaced?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines public lifecycle config and behavior for memory flush, transcript archive, queued system events, provider-owned sessions, and user-visible continuity.

options.title: Approve one opt-in rotation policy
options.body: Extend the core session reset contract with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader auto-split design
options.body: Keep this issue as a requirement but implement it only as part of the broader token-pressure/session-boundary work.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron/context-pruning/manual reset mitigations and avoid adding new core session lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Approve one opt-in rotation policy
recommendation.body: Extend the core session reset contract with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the daily reset and memory flush mechanisms that steipete introduced.
